visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Element Is Never Filled
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The even numbers should print 2 4 6 8 10, but the program prints 2 4 6 8 0.

solution.explanation: The fill loop stops one element early, so the last slot keeps the 0 that calloc put there. A loop over n elements needs the condition i < n.
